derivation.behavior: Selective repair redownloads damaged blocks without replacing good verified ranges.
derivation.canonical_behavior: Go invalidates damaged blocks, refetches exact ranges under current validators and re-verifies artifact.

invariants: Repair eligibility is decided against representation identity before checkpoint invalidation.
Only read-back-invalid committed checkpoint blocks are invalidated.
Exact damaged ranges are reacquired and recommitted under the current generation.
Good committed blocks remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
A changed representation aborts selective repair and preserves prior evidence for clean-restart policy.
Final checksum verification must pass after repair.
